limitations: Instrumented run adds observer CPU/memory/filesystem activity; not pooled with uninstrumented baselines.
Sequential counter reads are not atomic. In-window changes cover only recorded observations, without interpolation.
A cumulative maximum is not a percentile or an arrival-scoped maximum unless a new lifetime high is observed.
Archive total write time includes write/force path; it does not isolate fsync and is not CPU time. Bytes are not a write operation count.
Temporal overlap alone does not establish that archive writes caused a particular reply delay.
